_README.licence_note: Harvested fields are OpenStreetMap data under ODbL 1.0. Attribution is required. Do not remove this block.

fields.name_bn: Bangla form, from OSM name / name:bn.
fields.aliases: Variant spellings and local synonyms. Hand-entered; OSM has almost none.
fields.radius_m: Default by kind. A judgment call, not a measurement.
fields.source: osm:<type>/<id>, or 'manual' for a hand-added entry.
fields.reviewed: True only once a person has checked this row. The harvest sets false.
fields.ambiguous: True when every name form this entry has is shared with another entry. The loader refuses to resolve a query that matches only ambiguous entries, rather than picking one.

_README.hand_work_still_outstanding: aliases and radius_m. OSM spells the Mirpur 10 roundabout 'গোলচক্কর'; much of Dhaka says 'গোলচত্বর'. The gazetteer is only better than a general map once those synonyms are in.
